newsitem.title: USA: Claremont sees weak Q4 results.
newsitem.headline: Claremont sees weak Q4 results.

text.p: Claremont Technology Group Inc said Wednesday it expects to report net income of $528,000, or $0.05 a share, after charges for its fourth quarter.

The company said in a statement it expects to post revenues for the quarter, ended June 30, of about $18.6 million. It said operating profits are expected to be $819,000 after one time charges of $665,000.
Analysts had predicted Claremont would post fourth quarter earnings of $0.17 a share, according to First Call.
Comparative year ago figures were not immediately available.

Claremont said the weaker than expected results reflect the delay in one manufacturing and three communications engagements and the decision of one communications customer to proceed with an alternative solution.
"While delays are typical in our industry, it is highly unusual for four large engagements to experience such delays simultaneously," said Chairman and Chief Executive Paul Cosgrave.
Cosgrave said that despite the weak fourth quarter results he expects Claremont will continue on an aggressive growth path.

Fourth quarter charges included acquisition related write-offs of $495,000 and a charge of $170,000 for expenses incurred for a proposed secondary offering that was cancelled due to market conditions in the third quarter.
